notes.title: Patch 1.1.15 + Hadean Tactics in 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37660594/3a0add2bd9e1c1b40c8577c8eeff2539ca02b9b6.png[/img]

[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

Hope you all had a great holiday season and a nice start to the year! We wanted to share our plans for Hadean Tactics in 2025.

First up, we want to announce two major updates heading your way. These will be focused on enhancing the core game experience with:

[list]
[*] Visual improvements to the game's environments and unit models.
[*] New features to expand gameplay.
[*] Balance adjustments.
[*] Quality of life improvements.
[*] Additional refinements and polish across all aspects of the game.
[/list]
One of these updates will arrive as a DLC, which will introduce a brand new Hero to the game.

We've also been working on a few new projects! While we can't say much about them just yet, we're very excited and can't wait to show them to you.

In the meantime, we'll continue releasing patches to fix bugs and bring general improvements to the game.

Speaking of which, here are the patch notes for this update:

[h3]Patch 1.1.15[/h3]
⭐ Added music for Azazel and Cerberus.
⭐ When deleting a non-cloned Custom Hero, the gems spent with SP will be refunded.
⭐ Raised starting Crit chance for Custom Herores.
⭐ Improved UI performance for the cards in the Compendium.
⭐ Changed Card Blazing Circle target from Area to All Enemies.
⭐ Card Afterimage now works with Summons and Traps. Changed cost from 1/1 to 2/1.
⭐ Changed Phoenix Down resurrection HP from 25% to 50%.

-- Fixed legacy Custom Heroes not having a cap on their max Level while not having Mastery Plus enabled.
-- Fixed Hardcore mode issue where the Hero would disappear at the end of combat.
-- Fixed Auto Pause Last Second sometimes not working properly on low end devices.
-- Fixed Chalice of Burden relic effect not working in the right order.
-- Fixed Event Breaking Bad having some options with the wrong values.
-- Fixed Allies becoming Sick (Corruption modifier) at the end of combat after using a transformation skill e.g. Hatch, Dragon Egg.
-- Fixed some extra unit portraits showing up on the Compendium.
-- Fixed bug that enabled Library selection for Weekly Heroes.
-- Fixed Run Time counting in the Game Over screen.
-- Fixed tooltips clipping when there is too much text.

As always, if you have any feedback, suggestions, find any bugs, or you want to contribute with the translation of the game to your language, feel free to reach us on [url=https://discord.gg/Eumj8mF]Discord[/url], or here on the Steam community.

Wishing you all a great 2025!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37660594/15193291e10d0476e91d31262047cf4b6bba5435.gif[/img]

Cheeeeeers!!
Doug & Lili @ Emberfish Games

notes.title: The 1.1 update - Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37660594/9b8d305a0ad5c113df3f0349127feaaa15704d9a.png[/img]

[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

We are happy to announce that the 1.1 update for Hadean Tactics is now live! This update brings a ton of new content, including new relics, events, music, and more. We've also made several fixes and balance adjustments to improve the overall gameplay experience.

[h2]Update 1.1 Highlights[/h2]
Without further ado, here are the highlights for the 1.1 update:

[h2]Battle Log[/h2]
You can now view a detailed log of the battle, including damage dealt, healing done, and status effects applied.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37660594/d682a9e23fb2f63b879abf33da54a5eacf0cdcba.jpg[/img]

[h2]More Relics[/h2]
As requested by many players, we bring you MORE relics!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37660594/b72fbff6bd6558c988138730b6629093fc52c5a2.jpg[/img]

[h2]New events[/h2]
Introducing new events and some reworks, more to come!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37660594/316a83d6d615bba01b206d0fc3ec5647df44ae1d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hero Variant Endings[/h2]
All 6 Hero variants now have their own endings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37660594/a89deb76830d10a13dc9c320007f7e010e79ec84.png[/img]

[h2]New Music[/h2]
As mentioned before we've started working with Fogheart, a talented game music composer, to bring you a great OST experience. 
Right now we've added a new main menu theme, battle theme, and a boss track. The plan is for each Circle and each boss to have their own tracks. These will be steadily released as they are completed. 

https://youtu.be/4kT9AAz6I5g

[h2]Score Breakdown[/h2]
After each run, you can view a breakdown of your score and see how you earned each point.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37660594/bc791e17aa1dccbd7f932512515cdb5f979f7292.png[/img]

[h2]Shareable Custom Heroes[/h2]
You can now share your custom Heroes with other players, allowing you to try out new strategies, and share yours.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37660594/9b6037a50c7e643b677d420382326158e4656f72.png[/img]

[h2]Mastery Plus[/h2]
We've added a new Mastery system for custom Heroes that allows you to go over the default Mastery 10.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37660594/aaf948dc264d2031f2c6eb1b5e35ff3498da5232.png[/img]

[h2]New languages[/h2]
We now have 3 new languages:
- Japanese - Thanks to MASABO!
- Spanish (Spain) - Thanks to Jorge Alonso!
- Turkish - Thanks to Gökhan Kocaman!

[h2]Fixes, Balancing, and Polish[/h2]
We've made several fixes and balance adjustments to improve the overall gameplay experience. Some of the most notable changes include:
-- Wanderer units can now be removed from the Party, but will run away at the end of battle if they are left on the Bench.
-- You can now add Neutral cards to your Custom Deck.
-- Skipping Hero Upgrade and Banners now gives 50 Gold.
-- Changed Money Or Life event (added option to leave an ally behind to run away from the Bandits).
-- You can now right-click a map node to mark it as favorite.
-- Ephemeral clones now retain base damage from the source unit.
-- You can now sell runes during events.
-- Fixed Black Market inflation (overpriced Zombies).
-- Fixed sometimes not being able to get a specific Wing to access the end game.
-- Added final Boss achievements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37660594/da51004d5544adac7f823f42e8970bf57555f035.jpg[/img]

(Full patch notes at the bottom)

[h2]Special Discount[/h2]
To celebrate the release of the 1.1 update, we're offering a [b]35% discount[/b] on Hadean Tactics. So if you haven't already checked out the game, now is a great time to do so!

[h2]Join the community discussion[/h2]
If you have any feedback or suggestions for the game, or want to contribute with the translation of the game to your language, please do reach out, we are always open to improving! Join our [url=https://discord.gg/Eumj8mF]Discord[/url] to discuss the game with other players, report bugs, and share your strategies.

[h2]Thank You!!![/h2]
As always, thank you for supporting Hadean Tactics! We apologize for this delayed update, we wanted to bring it sooner but we encountered technical and mental issues that needed additional time to resolve. We're very grateful for your continuous feedback and support!

We hope you enjoy the 1.1 update, and we'll see you in the game!

Cheeeeeeeeeers!!
Doug & Lili @ Emberfish Games


[h3]Highlights[/h3]

-- Added Battle Log.

-- Added Score Breakdown.

-- Added Custom Hero Sharing.

-- Added Mastery Plus.

-- Added Spanish (Spain) language, thanks to Jorge Alonso!

-- Added Japanese language, thanks to MASABO!

[h3]Units[/h3]

[h3]Relics[/h3]

-- Knife Tentacle damage raised from 25 to 50 and now works every 2 damage (to avoid the game crashing).

-- Raised Vampire Fairy Lifesteal duration from 2 to 5 seconds.

-- Relic Cintamani Stone is now named Charmstone (sprite change).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37660594/e0b183a6dc39e7668320d2857261bb3cc258f6b6.png[/img]

[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

The day has finally arrived: Hadean Tactics is now out of Early Access with its 1.0 update! The fully released game features 3 Heroes, 6 Circles, 9 Bosses, Custom Heroes and Decks, along with two different game modes and the Weekly Hero.

[h2]The Journey of Early Access[/h2]

Three years ago, we challenged ourselves to make a deckbuilder game. One year later, we released it on Steam with these features:
[list]
[*]One Hero (the Inquisitor);
[*]8 draftable units;
[*]85 cards;
[*]3 Circles;
[*]3 Bosses.
[/list]

Fast forward to today, after many ups and downs, sweat and tears, we now have:
[list]
[*]3 Heroes (Inquisitor, Nightshade and Warlock);
[*]6 Hero Variants;
[*]30+ draftable units;
[*]9 Bosses;
[*]260+ cards;
[*]6 Circles;
[*]3 different Hero endings;
[*]The Crypt with Custom Heroes and Decks;
[*]70+ relics;
[*]50+ enemy types;
[*]Solo Hero Mode and Hardcore Mode;
[*]The Ethernal Records;
[*]80 Steam achievements;
[*]3 new languages;
[*]and much more.
[/list]

[h2]Thank you![/h2]

None of this would have been possible without you guys. Your feedback, suggestions, bug reports, beta tests, and constant support and patience have shaped Hadean Tactics into what it is today, and we are so honored and so grateful for having shared this journey with all of you.

Whether you've been here since the first demos of the Steam Festivals, or you're just arriving, our most sincere [b]thank you[/b]!

[h2]Release Discount[/h2]

As part of the 1.0 celebration, the game will be 35% off until September 4th!

[h2]So what's next?[/h2]

Coming out of Early Access does not mean we'll stop working on the game. We'll continue supporting Hadean Tactics with post-release patches, polishing the game, fixing bugs and improving the balance. With these patches there will also be some additional content, such as more relics and events. We also want to bring the game to more platforms, namely Switch and Xbox, and localize it to more languages.

[h2]Join the community discussion[/h2]

If you have any feedbacks, suggestions, find any bugs, or you want to contribute with the translation of the game to your language, you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/Eumj8mF]Discord[/url]!

Have fun!

notes.title: The Warlock Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The Warlock update is finally here, bringing you the third and final main Hero for the game! We know you've been waiting for this, so we're very excited to finally share it with you.

We also want to let you know that we're participating in [url=https://turnbasedfest.com/]#TurnBasedFest[/url] and the Game Development World Championship! As part of the festival, we're running a special 25% discount for 5 days, until December 12th. This is a great opportunity to grab the game at a discounted price and try out the new Warlock Hero.

We're also asking for your help in the [url=https://thegdwc.com/pages/game.php?game_guid=d27a99c4-0754-4a7d-ab87-d3ea326a90f5]Game Development World Championship[/url]! We need as many views, likes, and shares as possible to boost Hadean Tactics' ranking in the event. Every view, like, and share helps!

For the future, we want to focus on bringing controller support and officially adding localization to a few languages. After that, we will be polishing the game and gearing up for the 1.0 launch, where we will be bringing you the final two Circles and the last battle against the true boss.

Finally, we want to thank you all for your support and patience. A very special thanks to the fantastic beta players here on Steam and on [url=https://discord.gg/vzd2QyS]our Discord[/url] who have helped us a lot during this process. And a big thanks to all the beta players who have sent reports using our new in-game feedback tool! <3

Without further ado, here are the highlights for this update:

Have fun!



[h2]THE WARLOCK UPDATE[/h2]


[h3]Highlights[/h3]

-- Added Alatar, the Warlock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37660594/d2feba7d0560c090283d5b123b3f1e5e837db9ff.png[/img]

-- Added Warlock deck (75+ cards).

-- Added 7 new units, totaling 34 recruitable units.

-- Revamped events.

-- Added two game modes: Hardcore Mode (makes unit death permanent), and Solo Mode (start the run with only your Hero, unit banners won't appear).

-- Added Random Heroes: Traditional Random (a Hero will be randomly picked amongst your unlocked Heroes and Variants), and Dynamic Random (a random Hero and Card Library will be created for this run).

-- Added weekly Hero: play with a new, randomly generated Hero every week!

-- Added unit ban: if you don't like a unit, you can ban it and it will never show up in your runs.

-- Added Wanderer units: save them from enemies to recruit them! Wanderer units can't be removed from your party, and their death is permanent.

-- Added small dialogues for when you defeat each boss.

-- Added the shopkeeper.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37660594/ddff0e1c29dcb7db2b7cae0f69633ec31ff29e0f.gif[/img]

-- Added unit actions: in addition to manually selecting a target for each of your allies, you can now move them to another tile during battle. Each unit has two actions per battle.

-- Added in-game feedback tool: press F9 at any moment to send us a report with your feedback.

-- Added gameplay data sharing: this will help majorly with balancing the game using actual gameplay stats! You can toggle this in the Options menu.


[h3]Gameplay[/h3]

-- Added Weak status (Weak units deal 50% less damage).

notes.title: THE NIGHTSHADE UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

The Nightshade update is finally here! 

We know this took a long time; we encountered some issues that made it take a lot longer than we expected.
So first, we want to apologize for the delay. In the future, we will work harder so that this won't happen again.

We also want to thank you all for your patience and continued support. Special thanks to all the beta players on [url=https://discord.gg/vzd2QyS]our Discord[/url] who have helped us a lot during this process! We couldn’t do it without you all! <3

For the next update, we will be focusing on adding new areas and bosses, and expanding our enemy monster roster.

To celebrate the Nightshade finally arriving, we will also be running a special discount of 25% off for a week, until August 26th!

So, without further ado, here are the patch notes for this update!

Have fun!


These are changes influenced by the feedback from our amazing community!

********** 19/07/2021**********

[h2]THE NIGHTSHADE UPDATE[/h2]


[h3]Highlights[/h3]

-- Added Erith, the Nightshade.

-- Added Nightshade deck (55+ cards).

-- Added 9 new units, totaling 25 recruitable units.

-- Added Runes: consumable items to aid you in battle.

-- Added post-battle damage overview: a breakdown of how much damage was dealt during battle and by who/what.

-- Added manual targeting: you can manually select a target for each of your allies, once per battle.

-- Added Steam Cloud Save.

-- Reworked turns: End Turn button and Pause button are now the Battle Clock.

-- Added Sanctus boss relics: choose a powerful card-related relic as a boss reward.

-- Added Virtus boss relics: choose a powerful unit-related relic as a boss reward.


[h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3]

-- Bosses are now randomized per area.

-- Units can now be upgraded beyond level 3 (up to 5 + Star Crystal).

-- Changed how statuses are stacked.

-- Hero units can now be moved to the Bench.

-- Changed Splash (now half of the damage is dealt to all units).

-- Some Corruption Levels were reworked.

-- Added Stable status to cards (Stable cards are not automatically discarded at the end of your turn).

-- Added Enroot status (Enrooted units can’t move).

-- Added Slippery status (the unit will evade all attacks for a time).

-- Added Leech status (the unit will drain Health from the enemy and heal itself for the same amount drained).

-- Added Charm status (the unit is converted into its enemy side for a time).

-- Added Blind status (Blind units have a 50% chance of missing when attacking).

-- Added Pure Damage (pure damage ignores Shield).

notes.title: THE INQUISITION UPDATE
notes.content:
26/03/2021

[h2]THE INQUISITION UPDATE[/h2]

These are all changes based on the feedback from our amazing community! Thank you everyone for your continued support, we couldn’t do it without you all! <3

With this update, we have made some changes to the roadmap to better reflect the current stage of development.

[h3]Features[/h3]

-- You can now view your run history!

Every run you finish is now logged on the Stats tab in the Compendium, to be viewed at any time. Check how you did on your runs, who you had on your party, the relics you got, show off your victories to your friends!

-- Key binding is now available!

You can now make custom key binds to maximize your pro gamer moves.


[h3]Fixes[/h3]

-- Fixed Virgil’s Blessing giving a level 1 unit instead of a level 0 unit.

-- Fixed c16 Hero unit losing 200 HP instead of 500 HP.

-- Fixed scenario not showing before entering the first node.

-- Fixed winning Corruption 20 not registering as Steam achievement.

-- Fixed Shield Throw’s infinite loop.

-- Fixed boss death on c20.

-- Ephemeral units now won’t be considered when resurrecting the last dead unit.

-- Fixed camera flipping upside down (no more rollercoaster runs).


[h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3]

-- Shield won’t go down every second anymore.

-- Added Crucial status to cards (cards with Crucial will be drawn first at the start of the combat).

-- Added Endure status (each point diminishes the damage taken by 10%).

-- Added Confusion status (unit will target its enemies).

-- Dead units now can’t be moved to the bench.

-- Added nine new options to Virgil’s Blessing.

-- You can now get Virgil’s Blessing even if you did not reach the first boss in the previous run.

-- Virgil’s Blessing’s rewards are now scalable with how you did in the previous run (reaching the boss of the first Circle gives you the strongest rewards).

-- Ephemeral units now won’t inherit the original unit’s statuses.


[h3]Card Changes[/h3]

-- Shell now gives shield instead of damaging a random enemy.

-- Reduced Shield Throw’s cost from 2/1 to 1/0.

-- Reduced Area Shield’s value from 75/115 to 50/75.

-- Reduced Spiked’s cost to 0.

-- Reduced Random Shield’s value from 50 to 35.

-- Reduced Shield All’s value from 50/75 to 35/50.

-- Reduced Spiked Armor’s shield value from 75/115 to 50/75.

-- Reworked Eagle Eye (it now gives 100 mana when an ally uses a skill).

-- Reduced Armory’s value from 50/75 to 30/50.

-- Reduced Might All’s value from 75/115 to 35/50.

-- Reduced Bound All’s time from 3/5 seconds to 2/4 seconds.

-- Reworked Purgatory (it now deals damage to all allies and gives you 3 Energy, discards your hand and draws a new one. No more infinite Energy from clones).

-- Raised Shield All’s value from 15/25 to 20/35.

-- Reworked Hand Ritual (you can now select which card you want to deplete).

-- Reduced Bloodshot’s damage from 20/30 to 10/20 and shield from 100/150 to 75/115.

-- Raised Empower’s value from 50/75 to 75/115 and raised its Splash duration from 1/2 seconds to 2/3 seconds.

-- Raised Might All’s cost to 3.

-- Added Carbon Skin (gain shield every second for the rest of the battle).

-- Added Powerlifting (draw all cards with the word Might from your discard pile. They cost -1 this turn).

-- Added Hollow Armor (transform all shield into into Might).

-- Added Berserk (gain Might every second for the rest of the battle).

-- Added Mighty Deck (gain Might for every card with the word Might in your deck).

-- Added Fist of Midas (gain Might equal to your current gold).

-- Added Overflow (this combat, every time a unit gains Might, deal the same value as damage to a random enemy. Deplete).

-- Added Conjuring (remove the Might of all units in your party, deal damage equal to the value removed to all enemies).

-- Added Blood Card (take damage, draw a card. Long live Pixel Cattle Games).

-- Added Bloodletting (this turn, whenever an ally unit is damaged by a card, it gets healed instead).

-- Added Spiked Spine (for the rest of the combat, Spikes won't go down).

-- Added Spiked Shield (transform the current Shield into Spikes).

-- Added Sharp Hand (transform all cards in your hand into Spiked).

-- Added Forked (triple the current Spikes).

-- Added Spicate (units with Spikes will gain the stacked amount as shield when Spikes is triggered).


[h3]Unit Changes[/h3]

-- Units will now spend their mana at the beginning of skill usage, instead of at the end.

-- Changed Gargoyle’s skill (it now gains Endure and shield).

-- Marble Gargoyle’s Stonemason skill now gives an extra clone on Sentinel II instead of Sentinel I.

-- Marble Gargoyle’s Overseer mana bonus reduced from 3/3/4.5 to 1/2/2.

-- Marble Gargoyle’s base mana changed to 10 (there. Marble Gargoyle’s party is over).

-- Mighty Preacher is now an Inquisitor unit instead of an enemy unit.

-- Added Beholder in the place of Mighty Preacher as an enemy unit.

-- Added Light Preacher (gives more max health to all allies and also gives Protect).

-- Added Minos (Taunts enemies and gains shield).

-- Added Red Minos (inflicts Fracture and can apply Taunt to target).

-- Added Albino Minos (summons Griffin).

-- Added Griffin (inflicts Fracture on the target).

-- Added Melancholic Doctor (inflicts Fear on all enemies and can also inflict Decay).

-- Added Sanguine Doctor (inflicts Confusion and can knock back the target).

-- All units got a small stats change.


[h3]Alliance Changes[/h3]

-- Added Brute alliance (all allies have a 3% chance of inflicting Fracture to their target when attacking).

-- Added Bulker alliance (whenever an ally uses a skill, it gains Endure).

-- Added Tinker alliance (start each turn with a random Artifice card in your hand).


[h3]Relic Changes[/h3]

-- Chameleon Milk will now upgrade the transformed cards.

-- Added Hand of Glory (upon pick up, choose a card in your deck. Add Crucial to this card).

-- Added Witch Bottle (Everytime you draw a Burden, all allies gain shield).


[h3]Event Changes[/h3]

-- Event options now show the lore text first.


[h3]Option Changes[/h3]

-- Added option to mute audio when game is running in the background.

-- Added option to disable unit’s HP bar.

-- Added screen shake option.

-- Added option to disable blood particles.


[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]

-- Added map legend.

-- Added description tooltips to events that give you cards.

-- You can now target the ally units’ portraits (enemies’ portraits will be added soon).

-- Added more game speed control (you can now go slower as well as faster).

-- Removed satanism.


...And a lot more that we probably forgot to log!
